## Search course slides

```{=html}
<div class="course-search" role="search">
  <form id="course-search-form">
    <label for="course-search-input">Search the course</label>
    <div>
      <input id="course-search-input" type="search" placeholder="Search for a word or phrase" autocomplete="off">
      <button type="submit">Search</button>
    </div>
  </form>
  <p id="course-search-status" aria-live="polite">Search across all course slides.</p>
  <div id="course-search-results" aria-live="polite"></div>
  <div id="course-search-pagination" class="course-search-pagination" aria-label="Search result pages"></div>
</div>

<style>
  .reveal .slides section#search-course-slides { top: 0 !important; transform: none !important; padding-top: 1.2rem; box-sizing: border-box; }
  .course-search { max-width: 900px; margin: .6em auto 0; text-align: left; }
  .course-search label { display: block; margin-bottom: .45em; font-size: 1.15em; }
  .course-search form > div { display: flex; gap: .45em; }
  .course-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: .55em .7em; font-size: .9em; border-radius: .25em; border: 1px solid #aaa; }
  .course-search button { padding: .55em .9em; font-size: .9em; cursor: pointer; }
  .course-search-result { margin: .4em 0; padding: .4em .65em; border-left: 3px solid #9bc7ff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
  .course-search-result a { font-weight: 700; }
  .course-search-result p { display: -webkit-box; margin: .15em 0 0; overflow: hidden; font-size: .62em; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; }
  .course-search-pagination { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: .7em; margin-top: .55em; font-size: .7em; }
  .course-search-pagination button { padding: .3em .65em; font-size: 1em; }
</style>

<script>
(() => {
  const searchIndexUrl = 'search-data/course-search-index.json';
  const form = document.getElementById('course-search-form');
  const input = document.getElementById('course-search-input');
  const status = document.getElementById('course-search-status');
  const results = document.getElementById('course-search-results');
  const pagination = document.getElementById('course-search-pagination');
  const resultsPerPage = 4;
  let slides;
  let matches = [];
  let currentPage = 0;

  const normalise = (value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const words = (value) => normalise(value).match(/[a-z0-9]+/g) || [];
  const stem = (word) => word.replace(/(ations|ation|ments|ment|ingly|ing|edly|ed|ies|es|s)$/i, '');

  function editDistance(first, second) {
    const previous = Array.from({ length: second.length + 1 }, (_, index) => index);
    for (let row = 1; row <= first.length; row += 1) {
      let diagonal = previous[0];
      previous[0] = row;
      for (let column = 1; column <= second.length; column += 1) {
        const saved = previous[column];
        previous[column] = Math.min(previous[column] + 1, previous[column - 1] + 1, diagonal + (first[row - 1] === second[column - 1] ? 0 : 1));
        diagonal = saved;
      }
    }
    return previous[second.length];
  }

  function wordScore(queryWord, candidate) {
    if (candidate === queryWord) return 12;
    if (stem(candidate) === stem(queryWord) && queryWord.length > 3) return 9;
    if (queryWord.length > 2 && (candidate.startsWith(queryWord) || queryWord.startsWith(candidate))) return 7;
    const allowedDistance = queryWord.length > 7 ? 2 : 1;
    return queryWord.length > 3 && Math.abs(candidate.length - queryWord.length) <= allowedDistance && editDistance(queryWord, candidate) <= allowedDistance ? 5 : 0;
  }

  async function buildIndex() {
    if (slides) return slides;
    const response = await fetch(searchIndexUrl, { cache: 'no-cache' });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(searchIndexUrl);
    const index = await response.json();
    slides = index.slides.map(({ href, title, text }) => ({
      href, title, text, titleWords: words(title), textWords: [...new Set(words(text))]
    }));
    return slides;
  }

  function scoreSlide(slide, query, queryWords) {
    const text = normalise(slide.text);
    let score = text.includes(query) ? 50 : 0;
    for (const queryWord of queryWords) {
      const bestTextScore = Math.max(0, ...slide.textWords.map((word) => wordScore(queryWord, word)));
      const bestTitleScore = Math.max(0, ...slide.titleWords.map((word) => wordScore(queryWord, word)));
      if (!bestTextScore) return 0;
      score += bestTextScore + bestTitleScore * 2;
    }
    return score;
  }

  function renderResults() {
    results.replaceChildren();
    pagination.replaceChildren();
    const pageMatches = matches.slice(currentPage * resultsPerPage, (currentPage + 1) * resultsPerPage);
    pageMatches.forEach((slide) => {
      const queryWord = words(input.value)[0] || '';
      const matchAt = normalise(slide.text).indexOf(queryWord);
      const excerpt = slide.text.slice(Math.max(0, matchAt - 70), matchAt + queryWord.length + 120);
      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'course-search-result';
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = slide.href;
      link.textContent = slide.title;
      const preview = document.createElement('p');
      preview.textContent = `${matchAt > 70 ? '…' : ''}${excerpt}${matchAt + queryWord.length + 120 < slide.text.length ? '…' : ''}`;
      item.append(link, preview);
      results.append(item);
    });
    if (matches.length > resultsPerPage) {
      const pageCount = Math.ceil(matches.length / resultsPerPage);
      const previous = document.createElement('button');
      previous.type = 'button';
      previous.textContent = 'Previous';
      previous.disabled = currentPage === 0;
      previous.addEventListener('click', () => { currentPage -= 1; renderResults(); });
      const pageLabel = document.createElement('span');
      pageLabel.textContent = `Page ${currentPage + 1} of ${pageCount}`;
      const next = document.createElement('button');
      next.type = 'button';
      next.textContent = 'Next';
      next.disabled = currentPage === pageCount - 1;
      next.addEventListener('click', () => { currentPage += 1; renderResults(); });
      pagination.append(previous, pageLabel, next);
    }
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const query = normalise(input.value.trim());
    results.replaceChildren();
    pagination.replaceChildren();
    if (!query) {
      status.textContent = 'Enter a word or phrase to search the course slides.';
      return;
    }
    status.textContent = 'Searching slides…';
    try {
      const queryWords = words(query);
      matches = (await buildIndex()).map((slide) => ({ slide, score: scoreSlide(slide, query, queryWords) })).filter(({ score }) => score > 0).sort((first, second) => second.score - first.score).map(({ slide }) => slide);
      currentPage = 0;
      status.textContent = matches.length ? `${matches.length} slide${matches.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} found.` : 'No matching slides found.';
      renderResults();
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = 'Search could not load the course slides. Open the presentation through the published site or a local web server.';
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

## If you wish to make a mind, you must first invent the brain

:::{.columns}
:::{.column}

:::{.centerimg}
![](images/index/video/0_intro_sagan.mp4){width="68%"}
:::

:::
:::{.column}

:::{.card}
[Carl Sagan](https://it.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carl_Sagan){target="_blank"}’s famous line, “If you wish to make an apple pie from scratch, you must first invent the universe,” comes from the 1980 television series [Cosmos: A Personal Voyage](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BkHCO8f2TWs){target="_blank"}.
The quote is humorous, but it expresses a deeper scientific idea: <u>nothing exists in isolation</u>. An apple pie depends on ingredients such as apples, flour, sugar, and water, and each of these depends on long chains of physical, chemical, biological, and cosmic processes involving the Earth, the Sun, evolution, and the elements from which matter is made.
<u>The same reasoning can be applied to the mind</u>. Psychological functions emerge from the activity of the brain and the biological processes that shaped the nervous system. To understand the mind, we therefore also need to understand how the brain is built and how it changes.
:::

:::
:::
